findings.evidenceJa: 政経の補欠合格だった
findings.explanation: Takahiro was admitted from the waitlist to the Politics and Economics program or faculty, the same 政経 field identified elsewhere in the route. The English changes it to Public Policy, creating a different academic program and repeating the earlier systematic misreading of 政治経済.
findings.japanese:
「うん、さっき一緒に発表見てきてね。
政経の補欠合格だった…」
findings.todokanai: "Yeah, we just went to check the results together. He got into Public Policy because there was a vacant spot…"

findings.highlight: "If you really want to solve this on your own, then I won't say any more."
findings.evidenceJa:
「雪菜が自分で決着つけるって言ったから、
あたしはもう、何も言わない」
findings.explanation: Io states that because Setsuna said she would settle the matter herself, Io will say no more; the English makes this conditional on whether Setsuna really wants to solve it alone.
findings.japanese:
「雪菜が自分で決着つけるって言ったから、
あたしはもう、何も言わない」
findings.todokanai: "If you really want to solve this on your own, then I won't say any more."

findings.highlight: a portion of the students probably didn't feel like it was spring
findings.evidenceJa: 今日の合格発表も、一部の受験生にしか春を連れてきていない
findings.explanation: The results have brought metaphorical spring only to some examinees—the successful minority—while many remain in winter. The English says merely that a portion did not feel spring, reversing the restrictive population and weakening the passage's insistence that warmth has not yet reached everyone.
findings.japanese:
今日の合格発表も、
一部の受験生にしか春を連れてきていない。
皆に温かい日射しが注がれるのは、何日後のことだろう。
findings.todokanai: The results were posted today as well, and a portion of the students probably didn't feel like it was spring. I wonder how many days it would take before everyone can feel the warmth of the sunlight again?

findings.highlight: It's the year where we don't want any regrets
findings.evidenceJa: 一番後腐れのない年じゃないか
findings.explanation: Takeya calls fourth year the season of departure and therefore the year least likely to leave lingering complications or strings after romances. The English replaces his opportunistic no-strings logic with the wholesome slogan that students do not want regrets, blunting both the joke and Haruki's reply that Takeya says this every year.
findings.japanese:
「大学四年は旅立ちの季節。
…一番後腐れのない年じゃないか」
findings.todokanai: "But the fourth year in university is like a season where the journey begins. …It's the year where we don't want any regrets, right?"

findings.highlight: I can feel the guilt rising in you. Don't say I'm wrong
findings.evidenceJa: なんだか罪悪感湧いてくるだろ。俺、何も悪くないのによ
findings.explanation: Takeya tells the visibly shaken Haruki not to deny remembering so unconvincingly, because it makes Takeya himself start feeling guilty even though he did nothing wrong. The English locates the guilt in Haruki and ends with a different claim about Takeya not being wrong, reversing the comic emotional subject.
findings.japanese:
「思いっきり動揺したまま言うな。
なんだか罪悪感湧いてくるだろ。
俺、何も悪くないのによ」
findings.todokanai: "You really didn't have to say that so unconfidently. I can feel the guilt rising in you. Don't say I'm wrong."

findings.highlight: "Can you please continue from now on? I couldn't do anything for him. Can you please take my place?"
findings.evidenceJa:
「これからもあんなふうに、
今はなにもできないわたしの代わりに
彼をあっためてあげてね？」
findings.explanation: Setsuna asks Chiaki to warm Haruki in place of Setsuna, who can do nothing now; the English says Setsuna could do nothing, shifting current incapacity into the past.
findings.japanese:
「これからもあんなふうに、
今はなにもできないわたしの代わりに
彼をあっためてあげてね？」
findings.todokanai: "Can you please continue from now on? I couldn't do anything for him. Can you please take my place?"

findings.highlight: "As if I ever had even the slightest control over you! I'd actually appreciate it if you would listen to me for once. My doctor told me that I'm seriously going to get an ulcer at this rate."
findings.evidenceJa:
「ちっとも操られてないだろ！
むしろ少しは俺の思惑通りに動いてくれ。
この前医者で、マジ潰瘍だって言われたんだからな」
findings.explanation: Uehara says a doctor recently diagnosed him with a real ulcer; the English says the doctor warned he would get one at this rate.
findings.japanese:
「ちっとも操られてないだろ！
むしろ少しは俺の思惑通りに動いてくれ。
この前医者で、マジ潰瘍だって言われたんだからな」
findings.todokanai: "As if I ever had even the slightest control over you! I'd actually appreciate it if you would listen to me for once. My doctor told me that I'm seriously going to get an ulcer at this rate."
